about: Wave 9 (venues with capacity tickets and passes): the things the venue sells. share = relative share of customers, ratio = price against the going ticket, fleet = share of the venue's weekly capacity the item may use (0 = no capacity: bar, food, merchandise), use = capacity used by one sale (a season pass uses its visits), vc = relative direct cost of one sale as a share of its price (the engine rescales all vc so that at default prices the venue's cost of sales is exactly the trade's cost-of-sales share), edge = house edge, churn = relative monthly churn of a pass or membership, days = visits a pass or party covers. Wages, rent, fixed costs, depreciation and loans come from the company's own books.
